summary: Interview with Patrik Eriksson, CEO of Vimian, about their strategy in the pet health industry through acquisitions in niche segments. Vimian operates across four divisions: specialty pharma, medtech, services, and diagnostics, with 95% focus on dogs, cats and horses. The company has made nearly 50 acquisitions since listing in 2021 and plans to accelerate M&A activity.
key_takeaways: Vimian targets fragmented niches with unmet medical needs and untreated animals
Company aims for 300 million EUR adjusted EBITDA by 2030
Patrik Eriksson brings Danaher's management culture of focus and continuous improvement
Pet health industry has strong long-term growth trends with animals becoming family members
